description: Build a single structurally-valid element node from the real builder factory. Returns the node — edit its specials/style, then place it in a section's children.

opts.description: Factory opts: { text, src, width, height, style, config, specials, events, bindings, responsive, align }. align = horizontal placement in the grid cell: 'left'|'center'|'right'|'fill' (works on any element; buttons are content-width+centred by default — use align:'fill' to span the column).

name: new_element
